import sys

MOD = 10**9 + 7

def solve() -> None:
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    P = int(data[0])
    K = int(data[1])

    if K == 0:
        ans = pow(P, P - 1, MOD)
        print(ans)
        return
    if K == 1:
        ans = pow(P, P, MOD)
        print(ans)
        return

    vis = [False] * P
    p = 1
    cnt = 0
    while not vis[p]:
        vis[p] = True
        cnt += 1
        p = (K * p) % P

    ans = pow(P, P // cnt, MOD)
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
</translated_code>
